headline: Jimmy Kimmel Calls Trump’s Iran Deal ‘The Retreaty of Versailles’
context: “Trump’s answer to the question, ‘Who did you go to war with?’ and ‘How did it end?’ will be the same answer: ‘Iran,’” Kimmel said.
